chips.text: Recommended to Council
4 for, 0 against
Developers argued infill costs 5-10 times more than greenfield.
Committee directed staff to explore broader incentive options.
Future report will detail secondary corridor incentive implications.
Public speakers urged broader, stronger infill development incentives.
City will launch a Brownfield incentive pilot program this year.

segments.title: Staff presentation on new development incentives policy
segments.takeaway: Administration presented a new policy consolidating and modernizing development incentives, introducing affordable housing and city centre/corridor growth programs.

segments.title: Public comments: Patrick Wolfe
segments.takeaway: Patrick Wolfe advocated for expanding incentive eligibility to more established neighborhoods and busy streets, emphasizing the critical role of tax abatements for infill development.

segments.title: Public comments: James Wright
segments.takeaway: James Wright, a developer, supported the tax abatement program but expressed concern over proposed reductions and the removal of established neighborhoods from eligibility.

segments.title: Public comments: Randy Shabalow
segments.takeaway: Randy Shabalow requested the Riversdale Business Improvement District be fully included in incentive areas and advocated for 100% commercial tax abatements.

segments.title: Questions for administration
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration on the rationale for narrowing incentive areas and the implications of the proposed tax abatement changes.

segments.title: Committee discussion and motions
segments.takeaway: Councillor Jefferies moved to clarify vacancy requirements and requested administration to bring back options for tiered incentives across secondary corridors, BID areas, and established neighborhoods

segments.title: Motion for Riversdale BID incentives
segments.takeaway: Mayor Block moved that administration report back on potential development incentives specifically to support the Riversdale Business Improvement District.
